coverage.title: What’s in a name? Why Trump wants to rebrand AI as ‘super intelligence’

summary: US President Donald Trump wants to retire one of the technology sector’s most recognisable acronyms, arguing that the term “artificial intelligence”, or AI, is no longer fit for purpose.
